Faith and prayer

Praying for Montréal this winter

A weekly prayer chain for street teams, families and orphans.

By Brother Ronny [role to confirm]Published October 20, 2026Sample — to confirm

Everything we do begins on our knees. Before every outreach, every food drive, every workshop, we pray.

This winter we are starting a weekly prayer chain. Every Monday, subscribers to the “Prayer” newsletter receive three specific requests: a team, a family (first name only, with consent), a city.

"Whoever is kind to the poor lends to YHWH, and he will repay them for their deed." — Proverbs 19:17

To join, tick “Prayer” in your newsletter preferences.
